## Easy-return picks
- **Best starter:** **[Beetroot and Goat’s Cheese Terrine — Sainsbury’s](https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/gol-ui/recipes/articles/22-gluten-free-christmas-starters-to-share)** — serves 8; 55 minutes plus chilling. It is a four-ingredient, make-ahead layered starter that looks properly Christmas-table special, without last-minute work.
- **Best small gift:** **[Solutions for Men The Gym Edit — M&S](https://www.marksandspencer.com/the-gym-edit/p/hbp60739593)** — **£16**. A useful washbag containing 3-in-1 shower gel, roll-on deodorant and a cotton flannel; polished and practical rather than gimmicky.
- **Best smarter gift set:** **[BOSS The Scent for Men Duo Gift Set — Boots](https://www.boots.com/fragrance/aftershave/aftershave-gift-sets/boss-the-scent-for-men-duo-gift-set-10390610)** — **£71**. Includes 50ml EDT and 150ml deodorant spray in the same ambery/woody/fruity scent, so it feels like a considered present rather than a single bottle.

## Festive gluten-free starter shortlist — Sainsbury’s
All are from Sainsbury’s own gluten-free Christmas-starter collection (their recipes are described as gluten-free); check every ingredient label and avoid cross-contact if catering for coeliac guests.

1. **[Beetroot and Goat’s Cheese Terrine](https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/gol-ui/recipes/articles/22-gluten-free-christmas-starters-to-share)** — **serves 8; 55 mins plus chilling**. *Why it works:* deep festive colour, goat’s cheese richness, and most preparation can be done the day before. **My strongest menu-direction pick.**
2. **[King Prawns with Cucumber, Lemon Zest and Dill Dip](https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/gol-ui/recipes/articles/22-gluten-free-christmas-starters-to-share)** — **serves 10; 10 mins**. *Why it works:* the fast, crowd-friendly prawn-cocktail route, but lighter and fresher before a ham main.
3. **[Smoked Salmon, Pea and Parmesan Mini Frittatas](https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/gol-ui/recipes/articles/22-gluten-free-christmas-starters-to-share)** — **serves 12; 50 mins**. *Why it works:* very Christmas-y, easily portioned, and can be served warm or cold—ideal for relaxed entertaining.
4. **[Walnut Tartlets with Stilton and Dried Cranberries](https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/gol-ui/recipes/articles/22-gluten-free-christmas-starters-to-share)** — **serves 12; 60 mins plus chilling**. *Why it works:* the most overtly festive flavours; the gluten-free pastry shells can be made ahead. Note that it contains nuts and dairy.
5. **[Lemony Lentil Salad with Griddled Halloumi](https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/gol-ui/recipes/articles/22-gluten-free-christmas-starters-to-share)** — **serves 4; 10 mins**. *Why it works:* a quick vegetarian alternative with pomegranate and watercress that looks colourful on a sharing platter.

## Spiral ham: dependable cooking route
Use the **[Perdue Farms spiral-ham guide](https://www.perduefarms.com/en-US/cooking-ham-guide.html)** as a clear method, but defer to the pack if its instructions differ—spiral hams vary in whether they are fully cooked and in their specified safe temperature.

For a **fully cooked** spiral ham, the guide’s method is:
- Oven at **325°F / about 160°C (140°C fan)**.
- Wrap in foil, put **cut-side down** on a rack in a roasting pan, and allow **10–14 minutes per lb** (about **22–31 minutes per kg**).
- Add water to the pan for steam; glaze near the end, then finish hotter briefly.
- Rest under foil before carving.

Their simple glaze is equal parts **brown sugar and orange juice**, optionally with brown mustard or apricot jam. For a UK Christmas menu, the practical direction would be **terrine or smoked-salmon frittatas → glazed ham → sharp/green sides**: both starters balance ham’s sweetness and richness well.

## M&S stocking fillers for dads — under £20
1. **[Solutions for Men The Gym Edit](https://www.marksandspencer.com/the-gym-edit/p/hbp60739593)** — **£16**. *Why it works:* contains the genuinely useful post-workout basics—3-in-1 wash, deodorant, flannel—and a travel-friendly washbag. It is currently listed with a 4.8/5 rating from 9 reviews.
2. **[5 Pack Cotton Rich Ribbed Socks](https://www.marksandspencer.com/l/men/mens-socks)** — **£14**. *Why it works:* dependable, wearable and a little smarter-looking than novelty socks; five pairs makes it feel substantial for the price. M&S lists it at 4.5/5 from 28 reviews.
3. **[M&S Gold Sunburst Gift Card](https://www.marksandspencer.com/l/gifts/gifts-for-him)** — **£10–£500** (choose **£10–£20**). *Why it works:* not the most personal on its own, but a sensible, no-clutter add-in alongside chocolate or socks when you do not know his tastes well.

## Boots: slightly smarter men’s fragrance gifts
1. **[BOSS The Scent for Men Duo Gift Set](https://www.boots.com/fragrance/aftershave/aftershave-gift-sets/boss-the-scent-for-men-duo-gift-set-10390610)** — **£71**. Includes **50ml EDT + 150ml deodorant spray**. *Why it works:* premium presentation and a wearable ginger, maninka-fruit and leather-led scent; the matching deodorant makes the set feel complete. Boots showed it available to add to basket when checked.
2. **[Ralph Lauren Polo Blue EDT Trio Gift Set](https://www.boots.com/fragrance/aftershave/aftershave-gift-sets/ralph-lauren-polo-blue-eau-de-toilette-trio-gift-set-125ml-and-40ml-and-deodorant-10373995)** — **£60**. Includes **125ml EDT + 40ml EDT + 75g deodorant stick**. *Why it works:* versatile, clean aquatic/woody profile with citrus, basil, melon and suede; the large bottle plus travel size is especially good value as a proper gift. **Availability note:** Boots marked it temporarily unavailable online when checked, but offers store stock checking.

Prices and availability can move, particularly around Christmas, so it is worth opening the links before committing.
